channel.title: Anupam Baral — Technical Engineering Blog
channel.description: Technical articles on software engineering, Solana Web3 smart contracts, React/Next.js performance, and Python machine learning pipelines by Anupam Baral.

item.title: Architecting Yatra — A Decentralized Ride-Sharing Protocol on Solana
item.description: A comprehensive deep dive into engineering atomic ride contracts, driver reputation mechanisms, and real-time signalling systems using Rust, Web3.js, and Firebase.

item.title: Decoupling Large-Scale LMS Content Deliveries

item.title: Type-Safe AI Inference: Connecting Python Models to TS Gateways
item.description: How to bridge Python machine learning backends with TypeScript API gateways. Implement structural runtime validations to protect latency-critical production applications.

item.title: Optimizing Next.js Edge Rendering for E-commerce
item.description: Strategies for achieving sub-second LCP on content-heavy e-commerce pages using Next.js Edge runtime, streaming SSR, and aggressive caching.
